why: identityForLevelPick must only convert a CAMPAIGN boot into Practice. The Levels button is genuinely reachable on ?dev=1&mode=ffa (that boot keeps the campaign LevelSystem, so levelChoice is true and the campaign-shaped title affordances leave it on screen) and createLevelSystem's world() closure stamps flags.mode on every level it builds -- so an unconditional Practice here reports practice-result for a match the sim decided by last-slot-standing, and drops the stock strip mid-session. Scoped to the two suites that enter this from both sides. expectFailures is the count MEASURED by this harness against the scoped `tests` on this branch, not a repo-wide count.
